lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of discrete, high-luminance circular pixel clusters distributed across the mid and lower visible flank, arranged in a repeating, approximately equidistant grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased pixel luminance intersect with the circular clusters, creating a secondary grid-like visual structure along the lateral axis.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a distinct brightness gradient transition from high luminance on the superior edge to lower luminance on the inferior edge of each ridge.
